def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if not row or row[0] == background:
            continue
        color = row[0]
        end = 0
        while end < len(row) and row[end] == color:
            end += 1
        if end < len(row) and row[end] == background:
            out[r][end] = 1
    return out
'''
